info.name: OpenMetadata APIs Agent Executions Test Case Incident Manager API
List the test case failure statuses

params.name: testCaseId
params.description: Test Case ID

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number tests returned. (1 to 1000000, default = 10)

params.name: offset
params.description: Returns list of tests at the offset

params.name: startTs
params.description: Filter test case statuses after the given start timestamp

params.name: endTs
params.description: Filter test case statuses before the given end timestamp

params.name: testCaseResolutionStatusType
params.description: Filter test case statuses by status

params.name: latest
params.description: Only list the latest statuses

params.name: assignee
params.description: Filter test case statuses by assignee

params.name: include
params.description: Include all, deleted, or non-deleted entities.

params.name: testCaseFQN
params.description: Test case fully qualified name

params.name: originEntityFQN
params.description: Origin entity for which the incident was opened for

params.name: domain
params.description: Filter incidents by domain

items.docs: Get a list of all the test case failure statuses, optionally filtered by `startTs` and `endTs` of the status creation, status, assignee, and test case id. Use cursor-based pagination to limit the number of entries in the list using `limit` and `before` or `after` query params.
